title: One Card Left
description: A bedtime card game turns on Shane’s last card.
subtitle: Shane has a secret card up his sleeve in a bedtime game with Dad.

cover.alt: Shane laughing hysterically as he slaps down a Wild Draw 4 card in dinosaur pajamas.

blocks.html: Shane sat on the rug in his pajamas. Dad shuffled the Uno cards beside the fire. “One game before bed,” Dad said.
Shane looked at his hand. Red, blue, yellow, green—and one card he tucked behind the others. Dad laid down a blue card. Shane matched it. Dad played another. Back and forth the colors went.

blocks.alt: Shane in striped pajamas holds Uno cards while Dad smiles across the rug.
blocks.caption: Shane keeps one card hidden behind the others.

blocks.html: Shane kept peeking at his hidden card. Dad noticed. “Do you have a plan?” he asked. “Maybe,” said Shane. He tried not to smile.

🗣️ Say it with Shane

What’s Shane’s plan?
Shane played a red card. Now he held just one. “UNO!” he called.
Dad sat up. “Only one? Then I’d better think.” He chose a green card and set it on the pile. Shane looked at the green card. Then he looked at his own. Dad leaned forward.

blocks.alt: Shane laughs as he plays a Wild Draw Four card while Dad reacts with surprise.
blocks.caption: Shane reveals his surprise card.

blocks.html: “Can you play?” Dad asked. Shane waited one long second. “Yes,” he said. He turned over his last card: Wild Draw Four!

🗣️ Say it with Shane

One card left!
Dad stared at the card. “You saved that the whole time?” Shane nodded. Dad drew four cards, counting them aloud. “One, two, three, four.”
“I won!” Shane said. Dad gave him a high five. “You did. And you were very sneaky.”
They put the cards back in the box. The fire crackled. Shane curled up beside Dad for a moment before bed.
“Same time tomorrow?” Shane asked. “Deal,” said Dad. “But tomorrow I’m watching that secret card.”

🗣️ Say it with Shane

Good game, Dad.
